children: Sandeep Kumar has been elevated to Vice President – Data Technology & Analytics at WPP Media. He was previously Associate Vice President – Data Technology & Analytics at the company.
Kumar confirmed the development on LinkedIn, expressing gratitude for the opportunity and highlighting his focus on AI, data and technology-led transformation in his expanded role.

His experience spans cloud and solution architecture, AI and machine learning-enabled use cases, as well as generative AI and agentic solutions. His work has focused on areas including decision-making, personalisation and marketing efficiency.
Before joining WPP Media, Kumar held roles across technology and digital businesses, including Dunzo, GroupM and L&T Technology Services.
In his new role, Kumar will continue to work across data, technology and analytics, with a focus on applying AI-led solutions to marketing and business transformation.
